findings.description: The deployment user is granted unrestricted ec2:*, s3:*, lambda:*, and cloudwatch:* permissions against every resource. Compromise of its access key would allow broad control of compute, serverless functions, storage (including access to S3 data), and monitoring resources rather than limiting access to the specific deployment resources required.
